actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 60-ft.-radius centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates the Diamond Weapon’s holy attack that blasts the enemies around him/her
description.value: The caster emulates the Diamond Weapon’s holy attack that blasts the enemies around him/her. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of holy damage and are inflicted with the Dazzled status effect (Reflex save for half damage and negates the status effect). Creatures who fail the Reflex save are also inflicted with Silence status for 1d6 rounds. During the round that the caster casts this spell, the caster’s damage reduction is reduced to zero. Learned From Diamond Weapon and Omega Weapon.
